visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young boy wearing a black and white striped shirt, standing against a blue corrugated metal door. He holds a long, black fishing rod with both hands, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. (2) A woman in a white T-shirt enters the frame from the left, placing a blue plastic chair behind the boy. The setting is indoors, featuring commercial beverage refrigerators in the background, suggesting a recreational shrimp fishing facility. (3) The camera captures various angles of the boy sitting on the chair, holding the rod over a murky brown water pond. Close-ups emphasize his focused facial expressions and small hand movements as he waits for a catch. (4) The scene shifts to a top-down view of the water surface. Bubbles and ripples appear as the fishing line is pulled upward. A small shrimp is seen dangling from the hook, splashing against the water's surface. (5) The boy holds the caught shrimp close to his face, with a woman's hand assisting him. Unexpectedly, he tosses the shrimp away, and the camera follows the shrimp as it falls back into the water near a red net. The video ends with the boy's blank expression.

(2) A male narrator's voice enters with a professional, enthusiastic tone. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. The music remains consistent in tempo and volume. (3) The narrator continues with moderate speed, punctuated by the rhythmic pulse of the BGM. Faint percussive clicks and sounds of plastic chair movement are audible in the background. (4) Multiple voices shout excitedly ('有蝦！'), showing high arousal and positive valence. A distinct water splashing sound occurs as the music reaches a slightly higher energy level with synthesized melodic accents. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as a voice gasps in surprise. Loud laughter from multiple people follows. The narrator's tone shifts to a comedic, mock-distressed style while the BGM loops with rhythmic intensity.
